Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You cast a sliver of brightness that catches your foe like sunlight on broken glass.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
One visible creature within 5 squares
Duration
Damage is immediate; light lasts until the start of your next turn. Blinded decays normally.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

The light lasts until the start of your next turn; it does not reveal a target through opaque cover or override magical invisibility. Proposed NPC defense attribute: Agility.

Weak
3 radiant damage.
Standard
3 radiant damage; mark it with visible light.
Strong
5 radiant damage; mark it and apply Blinded 1.
